about: PG&E is one of the largest US utilities, providing electricity and natural gas to about 16 million people across northern and central California. It is headquartered in Oakland and listed on the NYSE (PCG). The company filed for Chapter 11 in 2019 after wildfires and emerged in 2020 after compensating victims. Revenue is over 24 billion dollars. Regulated utility with high local visibility, though a reputation affected by wildfires.

Intersect Power is an Oregon-based developer of utility-scale solar, battery storage and co-located power and data centre campuses, founded in 2016. Customers include large technology and industrial buyers, and Google was among the major partners. In late 2025 Alphabet agreed to acquire it. Funding of nearly 9 billion dollars, including debt, is shown. B2B energy developer with little consumer brand awareness.

SVOLT Energy Technology is a Chinese battery maker, spun out of Great Wall Motor, producing lithium-ion cells and packs, including cobalt-free technology, for electric vehicles and energy storage. Based in Changzhou, Jiangsu, it supplies carmakers including Great Wall Motor, Stellantis and BMW, with plants in China and a plan for Europe. It has raised more than 20 billion yuan and has been preparing an IPO. B2B component supplier with limited consumer visibility.

Westinghouse Electric Company is a Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania nuclear technology company that designs reactors (AP1000 and AP300), supplies fuel and provides services and maintenance to nuclear plants worldwide. It is owned by Brookfield Renewable and Cameco, after emerging from bankruptcy in 2018, and was part of a 2025 US government agreement to build new reactors. Customers are utilities and governments. B2B, with high profile in the energy sector.

wiki.title: Westinghouse Electric Company
wiki.text: Westinghouse Electric Company LLC is an American nuclear power company formed in 1999 from the nuclear power division of the original Westinghouse Electric Corporation. It offers nuclear products and services to utilities internationally, including nuclear fuel, service and maintenance, instrumentation, control and design of nuclear power plants. Westinghouse's world headquarters are located in the Pittsburgh suburb of Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania.
